     1→<!doctype html>
     2→<html lang="en">
     3→<head>
     4→<meta charset="utf-8">
     5→<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
     6→<meta property="og:title" content="SuperInstance — cells that watch back">
     7→<meta property="og:description" content="A reactive cell runtime where cells watch each other, act on what they see, learn in public, and book every decision into a receipt chain.">
     8→<title>SuperInstance — cells that watch back</title>
     9→<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2064%2064%22%3E%0A%20%20%3Cdefs%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%3ClinearGradient%20id%3D%22fl%22%20x1%3D%2218%22%20y1%3D%2218%22%20x2%3D%2246%22%20y2%3D%2246%22%20gradientUnits%3D%22userSpaceOnUse%22%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%3Cstop%20offset%3D%220%22%20stop-color%3D%22%234CF2D8%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%3Cstop%20offset%3D%221%22%20stop-color%3D%22%231FA8BE%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%3C%2FlinearGradient%3E%0A%20%20%3C%2Fdefs%3E%0A%20%20%3Crect%20width%3D%2264%22%20height%3D%2264%22%20rx%3D%2214%22%20fill%3D%22%230D1524%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Crect%20x%3D%2219%22%20y%3D%2219%22%20width%3D%2226%22%20height%3D%2226%22%20rx%3D%227%22%20fill%3D%22url(%23fl)%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%3Ccircle%20cx%3D%2232%22%20cy%3D%2232%22%20r%3D%223.4%22%20fill%3D%22%23052A26%22%2F%3E%0A%3C%2Fsvg%3E%0A">
    10→<style>
    11→/* ============ SuperInstance — deep tide design system ============ */
    12→:root{
    13→  --ink:#070B14; --surface:#0D1524; --panel:rgba(255,255,255,.028);
    14→  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.08); --line2:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
    15→  --text:#E8EDF7; --muted:#8A96AD; --dim:#5A667E;
    16→  --tide:#3FE0C5; --tide-dim:rgba(63,224,197,.14);
    17→  --signal:#FF7A6B; --signal-dim:rgba(255,122,107,.14);
    18→  --budget:#FFC46B; --budget-dim:rgba(255,196,107,.14);
    19→  --quantum:#9D8CFF; --quantum-dim:rgba(157,140,255,.14);
    20→  --r:14px;
    21→  --sans:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Inter,Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
    22→  --mono:"SF Mono","Cascadia Code",Consolas,"DejaVu Sans Mono",Menlo,monospace;
    23→}
    24→*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
    25→html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
    26→body{background:var(--ink);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--sans);
    27→  font-size:16px;line-height:1.625;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
    28→::selection{background:rgba(63,224,197,.28)}
    29→a{color:var(--tide);text-decoration:none}
    30→a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
    31→.wrap{max-width:1160px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px}
    32→.num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
    33→.mono{font-family:var(--mono)}
    34→
    35→/* ---------- nav ---------- */
    36→nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:50;
    37→  background:rgba(7,11,20,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
    38→  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
    39→nav .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px;height:60px}
    40→nav .logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.4px;font-size:16.5px;color:var(--text)}
    41→nav .logo svg{width:26px;height:26px}
    42→nav .logo .light{font-weight:300;color:var(--muted)}
    43→nav .links{display:flex;gap:22px;margin-left:auto}
    44→nav .links a{color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.4px}
    45→nav .links a:hover{color:var(--tide);text-decoration:none}
    46→nav .cta{background:var(--tide);color:#052A26!important;font-weight:800;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:99px;font-size:13px}
    47→nav .cta:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);text-decoration:none}
    48→
    49→/* ---------- hero ---------- */
    50→header{position:relative;padding:150px 0 90px;overflow:hidden}
    51→#heroFx{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;opacity:.55}
    52→header .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2}
    53→.kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;
    54→  color:var(--tide);border:1px solid rgba(63,224,197,.35);border-radius:99px;padding:5px 14px;
    55→  background:var(--tide-dim);letter-spacing:1.2px}
    56→.kicker .dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--tide);animation:pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
    57→h1{font-size:clamp(40px,6.2vw,74px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-2.4px;font-weight:800;margin:26px 0 20px;max-width:820px}
    58→h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--tide)}
    59→.sub{font-size:clamp(16px,1.8vw,19.5px);color:var(--muted);max-width:700px}
    60→.sub b{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
    61→.heroBtns{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-top:34px;flex-wrap:wrap}
    62→.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border-radius:99px;padding:12px 26px;
    63→  font-weight:700;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid transparent;transition:.18s}
    64→.btn.primary{background:var(--tide);color:#052A26}
    65→.btn.primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.1);transform:translateY(-1px);text-decoration:none}
    66→.btn.ghost{border-color:var(--line2);color:var(--text);background:var(--panel)}
    67→.btn.ghost:hover{border-color:var(--tide);color:var(--tide)}
    68→.stats{display:flex;gap:0;margin-top:56px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);
    69→  background:rgba(13,21,36,.6);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);max-width:760px;overflow:hidden}
    70→.stats>div{flex:1;padding:18px 22px;border-right:1px solid var(--line)}
    71→.stats>div:last-child{border-right:none}
    72→.stats .n{font-size:26px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.5px}
    73→.stats .n .u{color:var(--tide)}
    74→.stats .l{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:1.1px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:2px}
    75→
    76→/* ---------- section chrome ---------- */
    77→section{padding:86px 0}
    78→.secHead{margin-bottom:42px}
    79→.secHead .tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--tide)}
    80→.secHead h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,42px);letter-spacing:-1.2px;font-weight:800;margin-top:10px}
    81→.secHead p{color:var(--muted);max-width:760px;margin-top:12px;font-size:16.5px}
    82→.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}
    83→.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
    84→
    85→/* ---------- props ---------- */
    86→.props{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
    87→.prop{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:26px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
    88→.prop:hover{border-color:var(--line2)}
    89→.prop .glyph{width:40px;height:40px;margin-bottom:16px}
    90→.prop h3{font-size:18.5px;letter-spacing:-.3px;margin-bottom:8px}
    91→.prop p{color:var(--muted);font-size:14.5px}
    92→
    93→/* ---------- badges ---------- */
    94→.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;
    95→  letter-spacing:1.2px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid}
    96→.badge.value{color:var(--muted);border-color:var(--line2)}
    97→.badge.formula{color:var(--tide);border-color:rgba(63,224,197,.4);background:var(--tide-dim)}
    98→.badge.listener{color:var(--signal);border-color:rgba(255,122,107,.4);background:var(--signal-dim)}
    99→.badge.quantum{color:var(--quantum);border-color:rgba(157,140,255,.4);background:var(--quantum-dim)}
   100→.badge.economy{color:var(--budget);border-color:rgba(255,196,107,.4);background:var(--budget-dim)}
   101→
   102→/* ---------- demo patches (quilt stitch) ---------- */
   103→.patch{position:relative;background:var(--surface);border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.16);
   104→  border-radius:18px;padding:30px;margin-bottom:34px}
   105→.patch::before,.patch::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;
   106→  background:rgba(63,224,197,.5)}
   107→.patch::before{top:-3px;left:38px}
   108→.patch::after{bottom:-3px;left:38px}
   109→.patchHead{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:6px}
   110→.patchHead .no{font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--dim);font-size:14px}
   111→.patchHead h3{font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.6px;font-weight:800}
   112→.patchHead .badges{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-left:auto;flex-wrap:wrap}
   113→.patchSub{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;max-width:820px;margin-bottom:20px}
   114→.patchSub b{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
   115→.patchSub code{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;color:var(--tide);background:var(--tide-dim);padding:1px 6px;border-radius:5px}
   116→
   117→.demoGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.7fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:22px;align-items:start}
   118→@media(max-width:900px){.demoGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
   119→.stage{background:rgba(7,11,20,.55);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:16px;position:relative}
   120→.stage canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:8px}
   121→.sidePanel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
   122→.cellCard{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:14px 16px}
   123→.cellCard .ch{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px}
   124→.cellCard .cid{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
   125→.cellCard .cid b{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
   126→.cellCard .cval{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:15px;color:var(--tide);word-break:break-all}
   127→.cellCard .cexpr{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--dim);margin-top:6px;line-height:1.5}
   128→.cellCard .cexpr i{color:var(--muted);font-style:normal}
   129→.controls{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
   130→.chip{border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);border-radius:99px;
   131→  padding:7px 16px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);transition:.15s}
   132→.chip:hover{border-color:var(--tide);color:var(--tide)}
   133→.chip.on{background:var(--tide);border-color:var(--tide);color:#052A26}
   134→.chip.amber{border-color:rgba(255,196,107,.4);color:var(--budget)}
   135→.chip.amber:hover{border-color:var(--budget)}
   136→.chip:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed}
   137→input[type=range]{accent-color:var(--tide);cursor:pointer}
   138→.miniLog{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.8;background:rgba(7,11,20,.7);
   139→  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:12px 14px;height:148px;overflow:hidden;
   140→  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end}
   141→.miniLog .ln{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;color:var(--muted);flex:0 0 auto}
   142→.miniLog .ln b{color:var(--tide);font-weight:500}
   143→.miniLog .ln.sig{color:var(--signal)}
   144→.miniLog .ln.amber{color:var(--budget)}
   145→.miniLog .ln.violet{color:var(--quantum)}
   146→.miniLog .ln .t{color:var(--dim)}
   147→
   148→/* board (reversi) */
   149→.board{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,1fr);gap:4px;background:rgba(63,224,197,.05);
   150→  border:1px solid rgba(63,224,197,.18);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;max-width:460px}
   151→.sq{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);position:relative;transition:background .3s}
   152→.sq.legal{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(63,224,197,.35)}
   153→.sq .disc{position:absolute;inset:14%;border-radius:50%;transition:.25s;animation:drop .3s ease}
   154→.sq .disc.B{background:radial-gradient(circle at 34% 30%,#5FF5DB,#149A8C)}
   155→.sq .disc.W{background:radial-gradient(circle at 34% 30%,#F2EEE3,#B9B4A4)}
   156→.sq.last{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--signal)}
   157→@keyframes drop{from{transform:scale(.4)}to{transform:scale(1)}}
   158→.scoreRow{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center}
   159→.scoreBig{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:30px;font-weight:700}
   160→.whoB{color:#5FF5DB}.whoW{color:#F2EEE3}
   161→
   162→/* holdem */
   163→.holeRow{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center}
   164→.pcard{width:58px;height:80px;border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#141E33,#0B1220);
   165→  border:1px solid var(--line2);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;
   166→  padding:8px 9px;font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;font-size:19px;transition:opacity .5s}
   167→.pcard .st{font-size:13px}
   168→.pcard.red{color:var(--signal)}
   169→.pcard.black{color:var(--text)}
   170→.mcard{width:44px;height:61px;border-radius:7px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid var(--line);
   171→  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;font-size:15px}
   172→.mcard.red{color:var(--signal)}
   173→.mcard.hidden{color:var(--dim);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px}
   174→.streetRow{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
   175→.streetTag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:1.4px}
   176→.readBox{background:var(--tide-dim);border:1px solid rgba(63,224,197,.3);border-radius:var(--r);
   177→  padding:14px 16px;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--text)}
   178→.readBox b{color:var(--tide)}
   179→.fadeNote{font-size:12px;color:var(--dim);font-style:italic}
   180→
   181→/* desk */
   182→.meter{height:8px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);overflow:hidden}
   183→.meter>div{height:100%;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--budget),var(--quantum));transition:width .4s}
   184→.meterLbl{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px}
   185→.kv{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:13.5px;padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line)}
   186→.kv:last-child{border-bottom:none}
   187→.kv .k{color:var(--muted)}
   188→.kv .v{font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--text)}
   189→.kv .v.good{color:var(--tide)}
   190→.kv .v.bad{color:var(--signal)}
   191→
   192→/* ---------- landscape ---------- */
   193→.landscape{overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--surface)}
   194→.landscape table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:860px}
   195→.landscape th{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.4px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;
   196→  text-align:left;padding:16px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line2)}
   197→.landscape td{padding:15px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:14px;vertical-align:top;color:var(--muted)}
   198→.landscape tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
   199→.landscape td b{color:var(--text);font-weight:600;font-size:15px}
   200→.landscape .yes{color:var(--tide);font-weight:700}
   201→.landscape .part{color:var(--budget);font-weight:600}
   202→.landscape .no{color:var(--dim)}
   203→.landscape tr.us td{background:rgba(63,224,197,.055);color:var(--text)}
   204→.landscape tr.us td b{color:var(--tide)}
   205→.honest{margin-top:20px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:3px solid var(--budget);
   206→  border-radius:var(--r);padding:18px 22px;color:var(--muted);font-size:14.5px}
   207→.honest b{color:var(--budget)}
   208→.mapCard{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:26px;margin-top:26px}
   209→.mapCard svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
   210→
   211→/* ---------- ecosystem ---------- */
   212→.quiltGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}
   213→@media(max-width:900px){.quiltGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
   214→.quiltCard{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:22px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
   215→.quiltCard:hover{border-color:rgba(63,224,197,.35)}
   216→.quiltCard .seam{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(63,224,197,.5),transparent)}
   217→.quiltCard .qn{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:1.6px}
   218→.quiltCard h4{font-size:17.5px;margin:6px 0 8px;letter-spacing:-.3px}
   219→.quiltCard p{color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:14px}
   220→.quiltCard .pill{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--tide);
   221→  border:1px solid rgba(63,224,197,.35);border-radius:99px;padding:3px 12px;background:var(--tide-dim)}
   222→.quiltBanner{border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:22px;position:relative}
   223→.quiltBanner img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
   224→.quiltBanner .cap{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:36px 24px 18px;
   225→  background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(7,11,20,.92));font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
   226→.quiltBanner .cap b{color:var(--text)}
   227→
   228→/* ---------- manifesto ---------- */
   229→.manifesto{border-top:1px dashed var(--line2);border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line2);padding:70px 0}
   230→.manifesto .line{font-size:clamp(21px,3vw,31px);font-weight:300;letter-spacing:-.4px;color:var(--muted);
   231→  padding:10px 0;max-width:900px}
   232→.manifesto .line b{font-weight:800;color:var(--text)}
   233→.manifesto .line em{font-style:normal;color:var(--tide);font-weight:700}
   234→
   235→footer{padding:56px 0 70px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
   236→footer .wrap{display:flex;gap:30px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
   237→footer .flogo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:800}
   238→footer .flogo svg{width:22px;height:22px}
   239→footer .fl{color:var(--dim);font-size:13.5px}
   240→footer .fl .light{font-weight:300;color:var(--muted)}
   241→footer .right{margin-left:auto;color:var(--dim);font-size:13px;font-family:var(--mono)}
   242→
   243→@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}
   244→.flash{animation:flash .6s ease}
   245→@keyframes flash{0%{background:rgba(255,122,107,.25)}100%{background:transparent}}
   246→@media(max-width:760px){
   247→  .props,.quiltGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
   248→  .stats{flex-wrap:wrap}.stats>div{min-width:46%}
   249→  nav .links a:not(.cta){display:none}
   250→  section{padding:60px 0}
   251→}
   252→
   253→header::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;
   254→  background:linear-gradient(rgba(7,11,20,.42),rgba(7,11,20,.86) 62%,var(--ink))}
   255→</style>
   256→</head>
   257→<body>
   258→<nav>
   259→  <div class="wrap">
   260→    <a class="logo" href="#top" aria-label="SuperInstance home">
   261→      <svg viewBox="0 0 96 96" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="8" y="8" width="36" height="36" rx="9" fill="#fff" fill-opacity=".045" stroke="#fff" stroke-opacity=".16" stroke-width="3"/><rect x="52" y="8" width="36" height="36" rx="9" fill="#fff" fill-opacity=".045" stroke="#fff" stroke-opacity=".16" stroke-width="3"/><rect x="8" y="52" width="36" height="36" rx="9" fill="#fff" fill-opacity=".045" stroke="#fff" stroke-opacity=".16" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="70" cy="70" r="26" fill="#3FE0C5" opacity=".18"/><rect x="52" y="52" width="36" height="36" rx="9" fill="#3FE0C5"/><circle cx="70" cy="70" r="5" fill="#052A26"/></svg>
   262→      super<span class="light">instance</span>

   277→    <h1>The spreadsheet<br>grew <em>senses.</em></h1>
   278→    <p class="sub">SuperInstance builds on <b>quilt</b> — a runtime where cells don't just hold numbers,
   279→      they <b>watch each other, act on what they see, learn in public, and book every decision
   280→      into a tamper-evident receipt chain</b>. Below, four of those sheets are already alive.
   281→      No screenshots. The cells are running.</p>

   295→<!-- ================= WHY ================= -->
   296→<section id="why" class="reveal">
   297→  <div class="wrap">
   298→    <div class="secHead">
   299→      <div class="tag">WHY A NEW INSTINCT</div>
   300→      <h2>Three primitives the classic grid never had</h2>
   301→      <p>A formula computes. A <b>listener</b> notices. A <b>weight in a visible cell</b> can be
   302→         argued with, nudged, and improved — by you, or by the sheet itself.</p>
   303→    </div>
   304→    <div class="props">
   305→      <div class="prop">
   306→        <svg class="glyph" viewBox="0 0 40 40" fill="none"><rect x="3" y="3" width="14" height="14" rx="4" stroke="#3FE0C5" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="23" y="23" width="14" height="14" rx="4" stroke="#3FE0C5" stroke-opacity=".45" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M17 10h9a4 4 0 0 1 4 4v5" stroke="#3FE0C5" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/><path d="M27 15l3 4 3-4" stroke="#3FE0C5" stroke-width="2"/></svg>
   307→        <h3>Rules are cells</h3>
   308→        <p>Every rule — a trading clause, a poker read, a game's legality — is an inspectable
   309→           cell you can click, question, and edit. Not a hidden function. The sheet is the spec.</p>
   310→      </div>
   311→      <div class="prop">
   312→        <svg class="glyph" viewBox="0 0 40 40" fill="none"><circle cx="20" cy="18" r="9" stroke="#FF7A6B" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="20" cy="18" r="3" fill="#FF7A6B"/><path d="M20 27v7M14 34h12" stroke="#FF7A6B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M6 8c2.5 2.5 2.5 5 0 7.5M34 8c-2.5 2.5-2.5 5 0 7.5" stroke="#FF7A6B" stroke-opacity=".5" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
   313→        <h3>Watching is a primitive</h3>
   314→        <p>Listeners fire when a cell changes: flash a rule, halt a trade, refuse a payment,
   315→           play a move. Reactivity isn't a plugin — it's the substrate. The demos below run on it.</p>
   316→      </div>
   317→      <div class="prop">
   318→        <svg class="glyph" viewBox="0 0 40 40" fill="none"><path d="M4 32L14 20l7 6 12-16" stroke="#3FE0C5" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="33" cy="10" r="3.4" fill="#3FE0C5"/><path d="M4 37h32" stroke="#3FE0C5" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
   319→        <h3>Learning is visible</h3>
   320→        <p>Weights live in cells you can watch drift. Improvement passes gates, and every
   321→           promotion is a receipt in an fnv1a64 chain. You never have to trust the black box —
   322→           the box is glass.</p>
   323→      </div>
   324→    </div>
   325→  </div>
   326→</section>

   328→<!-- ================= DEMOS ================= -->
   329→<section id="demos">
   330→  <div class="wrap">
   331→    <div class="secHead reveal">
   332→      <div class="tag">LIVE · RUNNING IN THIS PAGE</div>
   333→      <h2>Four sheets, already alive</h2>
   334→      <p>Each patch below runs on a tiny reactive engine embedded in this page — the same
   335→         semantics as the full quilt runtime: value cells, formulas with declared dependencies,
   336→         listeners that fire on change. The mini-console in every patch is <b>real engine traffic</b>,
   337→         sampled, not theater.</p>
   338→    </div>
   339→
   340→    <!-- D1 OCEAN -->
   341→    <div class="patch reveal" id="p-ocean">
   342→      <div class="patchHead">
   343→        <span class="no">DEMO 01</span><h3>Ocean-as-a-Sheet</h3>
   344→        <div class="badges"><span class="badge value">336 VALUE CELLS</span><span class="badge formula">WAVE FORMULA</span><span class="badge listener">TIDE GAUGE</span></div>
   345→      </div>
   346→      <p class="patchSub">A tide field where every cell is a cell. The wave formula
   347→        <code>h′ = (Σhₙ)/2 − h</code> propagates energy through the grid; a <b>listener</b> on the
   348→        tide gauge lights the foam when |h| crosses the surge line. Drop a stone and watch
   349→        the cascade — reactivity as physics.</p>
   350→      <div class="demoGrid">
   351→        <div class="stage"><canvas id="oceanCanvas" width="520" height="300"></canvas></div>
   352→        <div class="sidePanel">
   353→          <div class="cellCard">
   354→            <div class="ch"><span class="badge listener">LISTENER</span><span class="cid"><b>tide.gauge</b> · cell D7</span></div>
   355→            <div class="cval" id="oceanGauge">h = 0.00</div>
   356→            <div class="cexpr">watch(tide.gauge) → if |h| &gt; 0.55 <i>· light foam cells, log surge</i></div>
   357→          </div>
   358→          <div class="cellCard">
   359→            <div class="ch"><span class="badge formula">FORMULA</span><span class="cid"><b>wave.step</b></span></div>
   360→            <div class="cexpr">h′(x,y) = (h↑+h↓+h←+h→)/2 − h(x,y) <i>· damping 0.994 · walls reflect</i></div>
   361→          </div>
   362→          <div class="controls">
   363→            <button class="chip on" id="oceanPlay">⏸ flowing</button>
   364→            <button class="chip" id="oceanDrop">drop a stone</button>
   365→            <label class="fadeNote">tempo <input type="range" id="oceanSpeed" min="1" max="5" value="3" style="vertical-align:middle;width:90px"></label>
   366→          </div>
   367→          <div class="miniLog" id="oceanLog"></div>
   368→        </div>
   369→      </div>
   370→    </div>
   371→
   372→    <!-- D2 REVERSI -->
   373→    <div class="patch reveal" id="p-reversi">
   374→      <div class="patchHead">
   375→        <span class="no">DEMO 02</span><h3>Reversi, self-playing</h3>
   376→        <div class="badges"><span class="badge formula">pick=Σweights</span><span class="badge value">wpos VISIBLE</span><span class="badge listener">apply-move</span></div>
   377→      </div>
   378→      <p class="patchSub">Two agents share one board sheet: <b>TIDE</b> reads a positional weight map,
   379→        <b>TERRA</b> counts mobility. The <code>pick</code> formula evaluates every legal move;
   380→        a listener applies the pick — which re-triggers the formula. The sheet plays itself.
   381→        When a game ends, the loser's <b>weight cells drift</b> toward what beat it. You are
   382→        watching the learning loop, not a replay of one.</p>
   383→      <div class="demoGrid">
   384→        <div class="stage">
   385→          <div class="scoreRow" style="margin-bottom:12px">
   386→            <span class="scoreBig whoB num" id="revScoreB">2</span>
   387→            <span class="fadeNote">TIDE · positional</span>
   388→            <span style="margin:0 8px;color:var(--dim)">vs</span>
   389→            <span class="scoreBig whoW num" id="revScoreW">2</span>
   390→            <span class="fadeNote">TERRA · mobility</span>
   391→            <span class="streetTag" id="revTurnTag" style="margin-left:auto">TIDE to move</span>
   392→          </div>
   393→          <div class="board" id="reversiBoard"></div>
   394→        </div>
   395→        <div class="sidePanel">
   396→          <div class="cellCard">
   397→            <div class="ch"><span class="badge value">VALUE CELLS</span><span class="cid"><b>agent.wpos</b> · TIDE's weights</span></div>
   398→            <canvas id="revWeights" width="240" height="240" style="width:120px;height:120px;float:right;margin-left:12px;border-radius:8px"></canvas>
   399→            <div class="cexpr">8×8 heat map <i>· darker = quiet square, brighter = territory the agent is learning to want</i></div>
   400→            <div class="cexpr num" id="revGames" style="color:var(--muted)">games played: 0 · last result —</div>
